newsitem.title: USA: Pulte buys 2.325 mln shrs for $73 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pulte buys 2.325 mln shrs for $73 mln.

text.p: Pulte Corp said Thursday it acquired 2.325 million shares of its common stock from two corporations controlled by James Grosfeld and his family for $73 million.
Pulte said the price of the stock, which was purchased on Wednesday, was equivalent ot the average closing price over the prior 30 business days.
The shares purchased constitute all of the shares that had been beneficially owned by Grosfeld, and represent approximately 9.9 percent of the company's issued and outstanding shares.
Prior to the transaction, Grosfeld resigned from the board, but will continue as a consultant, Pulte said.
Pulte Corp is the parent of Pulte Home Corp, a homebuilder, and Pulte Mortgage Corp, a national mortgage bank.
